// description: Ultimate minimal setup for using ImProcess as a Fiji/ImageJ-like stand-alone processor. No hardware devices are declared. The initial GUI starts as menus/toolbars only: core docks, optional analysis docks, napari layer controls and the Reconstruction dock are hidden until opened or data is displayed. Fiji-like image toolbar actions and Analysis toolbar panel shortcuts remain available; processor-backed tools register on demand. To use, also set 'enabled' to ['improcess'] in modules.json.
